intro.title: Which thought loop shows up most?
intro.hook: Choose the response closest to what you usually do. There are no right answers.
intro.boundary: This is a playful snapshot of your answers, not a mental-health assessment or a fixed personality label.
intro.method: Each answer adds one point to the thought loop it describes. Your most-selected loop is shown; ties use the first tied loop in question order.

question.0: It's 2 AM and you can't sleep. What's your brain doing?
question.1: You're about to meet someone new. What happens in your head?
question.2: You just sent an important text. Now what?
question.3: Something stressful happens at work. Your reaction?
question.4: Your friend seems distant lately. Your thought process?
question.5: You need to make an important decision. How do you handle it?
question.6: How do you think about the future?
question.7: You're overthinking right now. What does THAT look like?
question.0a: Replaying that embarrassing thing you said 3 years ago
question.0b: Imagining alternate timelines where you made different choices
question.0c: Rehearsing tomorrow's conversation word by word
question.0d: Listing everything that could possibly go wrong tomorrow
question.1b: You analyze their every facial expression during the conversation
question.1c: You imagine all 12 possible outcomes of the meeting
question.1d: You replay the conversation for 3 days straight afterwards
question.2a: Re-read it 8 times wondering if the period sounds angry
question.2b: Imagine every possible way they might interpret your words
question.2c: Spiral into panic because they read it but haven't replied
question.2d: Draft 5 follow-up messages, send none of them
question.3a: Can't sleep — your mind runs in circles all night
question.3b: Immediately jump to: I'm going to get fired, lose my house, live in a van
question.3c: Build a 47-step contingency plan for every possible outcome
question.3d: Obsess over what you could have done differently
question.4a: Analyze their last 20 messages for hidden meaning
question.4b: Practice 'Are you mad at me?' in 15 different tones
question.4c: Imagine the 8 reasons they might secretly hate you
question.4d: Lie awake replaying every interaction for clues
question.5a: Research obsessively until you have 47 browser tabs open
question.5b: Focus entirely on what could go wrong with each option
question.5c: Ask everyone you know, then overanalyze all their advice
question.5d: Decide, then immediately second-guess yourself for weeks
question.6a: Catastrophize about unlikely disasters in vivid detail
question.6b: Create detailed mental simulations of every possible path
question.6c: Lose sleep over things that are literally years away
question.6d: Rehearse hypothetical future conversations that may never happen
question.7a: Overthinking about how much you overthink (inception!)
question.7b: Analyzing exactly WHY you overthink everything
question.7c: Building theories about your own thought patterns
question.7d: Worrying that overthinking will eventually ruin your life

spiral.name: 3AM Spiral Thinker
spiral.tagline: Your brain has no off switch, especially at 2 AM.

architect.tagline: You've already planned for 47 alternate timelines.

rehearser.tagline: You've practiced this conversation 12 times already.

catastrophizer.tagline: My hobby? Imagining worst-case scenarios in 4K.

result.calculation: You chose answers linked to this loop {points} out of {total} times.
result.boundary: It summarizes these eight choices only. It does not measure anxiety, ability, or personality.
